## Projects (all live demos)

### DRAPE — Clothing Store
- URL: https://saintlife.dev/shop/
- Type: Website Build
- Description: Full e-commerce clothing store. 31 products across 6 categories with color variants, size selectors, and a live cart. Built with Tailwind CSS and vanilla JavaScript.

### Email Support Agent
- URL: https://saintlife.dev/agents/email-support/
- Type: Custom AI Agent
- Description: Paste support documentation and an incoming customer email — receive a grounded, ready-to-send reply via Claude API. Does not hallucinate information outside the provided docs.

### Competitor Analysis Agent
- URL: https://saintlife.dev/agents/competitor-analysis/
- Type: Custom AI Agent
- Description: Analyse any business and surface competitive intelligence. Structured output for positioning, strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities.

### Email Autoresponder Pipeline
- URL: https://saintlife.dev/workflows/email-autoresponder/
- Type: Agent Workflow
- Description: 5-step pipeline — watches Gmail inbox, parses unread emails, loads support docs, drafts a Claude-powered reply, sends it in-thread, marks email read. Fully automated.

### Daily Briefing Pipeline
- URL: https://saintlife.dev/workflows/daily-briefing/
- Type: Agent Workflow
- Description: Runs each morning — fetches topic-specific news, grabs weather, sends to Claude for summarisation, delivers a clean digest to inbox, logs to Google Sheets.

### Ember & Oak — Restaurant Site
- URL: https://saintlife.dev/websites/restaurant/
- Type: Website Build
- Description: Full website for a wood-fired restaurant. Tabbed menu, image gallery, reservation form, opening hours. Mobile-first responsive design.

## Skills & Stack

- AI/Agents: Claude API (Anthropic), OpenAI, prompt engineering, tool use, multi-step orchestration
- Automation: Gmail API, Google Sheets API, Python pipelines
- Design: responsive layouts, animation, dark/light theming, WebGL shaders
